name: sanitize-secrets
description: Redacts API keys and tokens from tool results and prompts, and lets the model use stored keys without reading them.

vault.title: Stored secrets
vault.description: JSON object of secrets the model may use without reading: {"<name>": {"value", "hosts": [...], "header", "template": "Bearer {}"}}. Set it with `claude plugin configure sanitize-secrets --values-stdin` in your own terminal.
